title: POST /internal/v1/assessments request (private)
description: Gateway -> detector. Carries the resolved task and the ORIGINAL passage, unmodified. The detector receives no policy and no mode: it assesses, it does not decide. Never exposed publicly.

text.description: Byte-for-byte identical to the text the caller submitted. No normalization, truncation or span removal, whatever the language_hint says.

deadline_ms.description: Remaining budget for the whole assessment, including any provider retry. Shared with the gateway's end-to-end deadline rather than restarting it.
